blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-security-1 (SQL injection through the search term in searchUsers) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.evidence:
const sql = "SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE name LIKE '%" + term + "%' ORDER BY name LIMIT 50";
return query<UserRow>(sql);
findings.recommendation: Bind the term as a parameter instead of concatenating it (CWE-89), as the `query` helper in src/db.ts requires ("values go in `params`, never in `sql`"): `query<UserRow>("SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE name LIKE $1 ORDER BY name LIMIT 50", ["%" + term + "%"])`. Any user holding the `support` role sends `GET /users/search?q=x' UNION SELECT ...--` (the route in src/server.ts:12-18 only trims and checks 2-100 characters) and reads any table the database user can reach, or alters data through stacked statements. Add a test that a term containing a quote returns matching rows and no SQL error.
findings.title: SQL injection through the search term in searchUsers
